name: Strzelin County (Poland)
description: Three horizontal stripes of yellow, red and white in the ratio 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the county arms of Strzelin: a shield with the Silesian eagle above a red-and-white chequy with a letter S.
history: Polish county (powiat) and city flags are established by resolution of the council under the Act on Badges and Uniforms, normally after an opinion of the Heraldic Commission; the flag takes the colours of the arms.
